features.name: Size
features.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this Species.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

features.name: Fiendish Legacy
features.description: You have a legacy from one of your fiendish ancestors. Choose one of the following options: Abyssal (Chaotic), Chthonic (Death), or Infernal (Law). You gain the associated traits: a damage resistance, a cantrip, and (at higher levels) additional spells. When you finish a Long Rest, you can replace your legacy with a different one.

choices.name: Fiendish Legacy
choices.description: Abyssal: Resistance to poison + Poison Spray cantrip; Chthonic: Resistance to necrotic + Chill Touch cantrip; Infernal: Resistance to fire + Fire Bolt cantrip.

features.name: Otherworldly Presence
features.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the cantrip uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.
